answer: Each new identity locks a bond of 45,000 POA in a shale ledger: its work is pressed into layered strata, each layer stamped saffron only after a falcon patrol — three random auditors — verifies one real transaction. A fake layer cracks the whole stratum: the bond burns, half goes to the reporter, the identity is banned 14 epochs and its shale slot is revoked. Forging 1,000 fake identities costs 1,000 × 45,000 = 45,000,000 POA, while an honest agent pays one bond of 45,000 POA once. The limit: falcon patrols sample only a fraction of strata each epoch, so a patient fake can hide between sweeps.
